newsitem.title: USA: HFS's Agency sells replacement car business.
newsitem.headline: HFS's Agency sells replacement car business.

text.p: HFS Inc on Thursday said its indirect subsidiary Agency Rent-A-Car Inc has agreed to sell its insurance replacement rental car business to Enterprise Rent-A-Car Co.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.

In a statement, HFS vice chairman Stephen Holmes said, "We have established very aggressive goals for our newly acquired Avis subsidiary and the sale of Agency will permit Avis management to focus its full attention on meeting and exceeding these objectives."
Officials at HFS were not available for comment.

HFS is a consumer services company. The company is the largest franchisor of hotels and residential real estate brokerage offices, owns Avis Inc, the world's second largest rental car system, and Resort Condominiums International Inc, the largest provider of vacation timeshare exchange services.
